hints.title: Binary Balance Zero Sum Transformation
hints.text: A subarray has equal zeros and ones if their count difference is zero. How can converting 0 to -1 transform this problem into finding a subarray with sum 0?

hints.title: Matching Prefix Sum Zero Window Invariant
hints.text: If cumulative sum at index j equals cumulative sum at index i, the subarray between i and j has sum equal to zero.

hints.title: First Seen Prefix Index Lookup Procedure
hints.text: Track a cumulative prefix total treating 1 as +1 and 0 as -1. Record the earliest index of each prefix total in a lookup table initialized with sum zero at index -1. When an existing prefix total repeats at index i, update the maximal window length with i minus its earliest index.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input element count or target integer bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(N^2) subarrays by counting zeros and ones takes O(N^2) time, leading to time limit exceeded for N up to 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using a lookup table of first seen prefix sums solves the query in O(N) time with O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize transforming binary values into +1 and -1 and using prefix sum lookup.
